name: linear
description: Sidebar of your assigned Linear issues; Start creates a git worktree and begins implementing the issue.

repoPath.title: Repository path
repoPath.description: Git repository to create worktrees in. Empty: the session's working directory.

baseRef.title: Base ref
baseRef.description: Branch or commit a new issue branch starts from.

startMode.title: Start mode
startMode.description: session: this session enters the worktree and implements. agent: a background subagent implements inside the worktree.

moveToInProgress.title: Move to In Progress
moveToInProgress.description: Set the issue's Linear status to In Progress when Start is pressed.

linearServer.title: Linear MCP server
linearServer.description: The Linear MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. When it is not connected, "claude.ai Linear" and "linear" are tried too.

statusColors.title: Custom status colors
statusColors.description: Colors for statuses Linear's MCP does not expose, as Name=#HEX pairs: Blocked=#EB5757, Test=#26B5CE. Standard statuses use Linear's defaults.
